subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He travelled for more than thirty years. (b) He boarded a ship for Chittagong and it took him about six months to reach there. Board & Test Questions : First Paper (c) Outside the town of Sylhet two persons met him. (d) Ibn Batuta became very pleased hearing it. (e) They said that they were sent by Shah Jalal to receive him. (f) From there he has to walk for another month to reach Sylhet. (g) You might have heard the name of Ibn Batuta. (h) He heard the name of Shah Jalal of Sylhet and decided to visit him.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 15 — Viqarunnisa Noon School & College, Dhaka
